objectiveShort: Looking to build applications with efficient, intelligent user experiences?
objective: Senior Software Engineer and Cloud Architect with extensive experience designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-native applications and robust web platforms. Proven expertise across multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), paired with a deep commitment to DevOps principles, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and continuous improvement. A polyglot developer highly proficient in Java (Spring), Python, JavaScript (Node.js, Bun, modern frontends), and C# (.NET), as well as SQL and NoSQL databases. Passionate about applying Data Science, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning to optimize workflows, modernize legacy systems, and deliver scalable, secure software solutions.

roles.title: Senior Information Technology Analyst
bullets: Develop and maintain Java-based enterprise applications, delivering ongoing support and enhancements to legacy systems to ensure stability and performance.
Partner with stakeholders and clients to gather requirements and design new application solutions, translating business needs into scalable technical architecture.

roles.title: Cloud Engineer and Architect
bullets: Owned end-to-end cloud administration and architecture, designing scalable, resilient environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP to support enterprise-grade application workloads.
Architected and implemented advanced CI/CD pipelines, automating build, test, and deployment processes to accelerate release cycles and reduce manual intervention.

Designed and provisioned cloud infrastructure from the ground up — networking, security groups, IAM policies, and compute resources — establishing standardized, repeatable environment setups for engineering teams.

roles.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
bullets: Led the ideation, architectural planning, and end-to-end development of new enterprise applications and high-impact software features.
Championed the adoption of DevOps culture and practices, fostering a sustainable, secure, and highly efficient coding environment.
Conducted active AI research and applied machine learning insights to optimize internal workflows and enhance system capabilities.
Ensured rigorous compliance with current industry legislation while upholding best-in-class software architecture standards.

roles.title: Middle Backend Developer
bullets: Engineered and deployed high-performance backend features for web platforms using Node.js.
Collaborated closely with Tech Leads and Scrum Masters in an Agile environment, translating customer expectations into scalable product increments during rapid sprints.

roles.title: Middle Fullstack Developer
bullets: Architected and delivered new web platforms while executing critical maintenance and refactoring of legacy codebases.
Engineered scalable microservices in Python and integrated third-party APIs to expand platform functionality.

roles.title: Junior Fullstack Developer
bullets: Developed and launched the corporate website, aligning technical implementation with executive design expectations.
Engaged in co-programming initiatives with Senior Developers to accelerate technical proficiency and ensure code quality.
